blurb: H2O Watersportz offers pontoon, tritoon, and center console boat rentals with delivery or pickup at local boat ramps. Rentals include safety gear and thorough orientation covering boat operation and safety. Boater's license is required for operators born in 1988 or later; tours and fishing charters do not require a license or credit card.
